es: Inferir la motivación y las emociones de un personaje a partir de sus acciones, sus silencios y los detalles de la descripción.

teaching.en: His silence suggests that he is reluctant to talk about his brother.
teaching.es: Su silencio sugiere que es reacio a hablar de su hermano.
teaching.explanationEs: Detalle + suggests that + motivo deducido: el detalle es la prueba y la oración con that es tu inferencia.
segments: His silence suggests that he is
reluctant to talk about his brother.
teaching.audioText: His silence suggests that he is reluctant to talk about his brother.

teaching.en: The fact that she avoids his eyes is evidence that she feels guilty.
teaching.es: El hecho de que evite su mirada es una prueba de que se siente culpable.
teaching.explanationEs: Evidence that + oración presenta un indicio; avoids va seguido de un nombre o de -ing.
segments: The fact that she avoids his eyes
is evidence that she feels guilty.
teaching.audioText: The fact that she avoids his eyes is evidence that she feels guilty.

teaching.en: Her motive was simple: she wanted to protect her little sister.
teaching.es: Su motivo era sencillo: quería proteger a su hermana pequeña.
teaching.explanationEs: Motive es el porqué de una acción; se explica con wanted to + verbo base.
segments: Her motive was simple: she wanted
teaching.audioText: Her motive was simple: she wanted to protect her little sister.

teaching.en: He laughs a lot, but his hands are shaking, so he might be more nervous than he admits.
teaching.es: Se ríe mucho, pero le tiemblan las manos, así que quizá esté más nervioso de lo que admite.
teaching.explanationEs: Might be expresa una deducción posible; admits contrasta lo que dice con lo que hace.
segments: He laughs a lot, but his hands are shaking,
so he might be more nervous than he admits.
teaching.audioText: He laughs a lot, but his hands are shaking, so he might be more nervous than he admits.

teaching.en: She keeps the letter in her bag, so she must be hiding something.
teaching.es: Guarda la carta en su bolso, así que debe de estar escondiendo algo.
teaching.explanationEs: Must be + -ing: deducción casi segura a partir de un detalle.
segments: She keeps the letter in her bag,
so she must be hiding something.
teaching.audioText: She keeps the letter in her bag, so she must be hiding something.

prompt.es: ¿Qué sugiere el detalle de las dos tazas del cuento?

choices.text: He often invites visitors to have tea.
He still misses someone who used to sit with him.
He is learning to cook for two people.

feedback.es: Poner dos tazas estando solo apunta a un recuerdo: echa de menos a alguien que ya no está.

hint.es: Pregúntate por qué alguien que vive solo prepara un sitio más cada tarde.

origin.text: Every evening, Mr Brown puts two cups on the table, although he lives alone.

prompt.es: Completa: «Miraba la puerta sin parar, así que debe de esperar a alguien.»

feedback.es: Must be expresa una deducción casi segura basada en lo que hace.

hint.es: Es una deducción casi segura: usa el modal que no lleva to.

origin.text: She kept looking at the door, so she ___ be waiting for someone.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Su silencio sugiere que evita el problema.»

answer.text: His silence suggests that he avoids the problem

feedback.es: El detalle va delante, suggests that introduce la inferencia y avoids describe la actitud.

hint.es: Primero el detalle, luego suggests that y por fin la oración.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada detalle con la inferencia más razonable.

pairs: She checks her phone every minute.
He laughs, but his hands shake.

pairs.es: Está más nervioso de lo que admite

pairs: She gives away her old books.

feedback.es: Cada detalle observable apunta a un motivo: la espera, el nervio, la despedida o el dolor.

pairs.es: Está más nervioso de lo que admite

prompt.es: Escucha y elige el motivo que sugiere la escena.

choices.text: He is sure that he will pass without studying.
He wants to help the others with their homework.
He wants to look confident while he is really worried.

feedback.es: Lo que dice (fácil) contradice lo que hace (estudiar toda la noche): esconde su preocupación.

origin.audio: Tom told everyone that the test was easy, yet he spent the whole night studying.

prompt.es: Completa tres inferencias con la palabra que falta.

feedback.es: Suggests introduce la inferencia, avoids va con -ing y must se combina con el verbo base be.

sentences: His silence ___ that he is reluctant to talk.
She ___ looking at him, because she feels guilty.
He must ___ afraid of the dog.

prompt.es: ¿Qué motivo explica mejor la actitud de Sara?

choices.text: She is afraid that Tom will laugh at her work.
She wants Tom to help her rewrite it.
She has forgotten what the speech is about.

feedback.es: Ensaya mucho pero no deja que lean su texto: lo más razonable es el miedo a la crítica.

origin.text: Sara arrived early, rehearsed her speech twice and still refused to let Tom read it.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué sugiere la actitud de Carlos.

choices.text: He is proud of his brother and wants to talk.
The subject makes him sad, so he avoids it.
He has forgotten that he has a brother.

feedback.es: Cambiar de tema cada vez que se pregunta por el verano apunta a un asunto doloroso que evita.

origin.audio: Carlos never mentions his brother, and he changes the subject whenever someone asks about the summer.

prompt.es: Completa: «Se ríe, pero le tiemblan las manos; quizá esté más nervioso de lo que dice.»

feedback.es: Might expresa una deducción posible, no segura, a partir de un detalle que contradice su risa.

origin.text: He laughs, but his hands are shaking; he ___ be more nervous than he says.

prompt.es: Escribe qué sugieren estos detalles y cuál puede ser el motivo de Mia.

answer.text: These details suggest that Mia is leaving the city. She must be looking for a new start, because she wants to begin again somewhere else.
accepted: These details suggest that Mia is leaving the city. She must be looking for a new start, because she wants to begin again somewhere else.
Her actions suggest that she is moving away. She might be hoping to start a new life, because she wants a change.
All this suggests that Mia is going away. She must be preparing to leave, because she has a new plan.

feedback.es: Una buena inferencia nombra el detalle, deduce el plan de Mia con suggests that o must be y añade su posible motivo.

origin.text: Mia regala sus libros viejos, se despide de sus vecinos y cierra su cuenta del banco. Escribe dos frases: una inferencia con suggests that o must be, y un posible motivo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué se puede inferir de Leo en esta escena?

choices.text: He is very hungry and wants more food.
He is planning to cook a new dinner.
He is probably worried about something.

feedback.es: Dice que está bien, pero no come: la contradicción apunta a una preocupación que no quiere mostrar.

origin.text: «I am fine,» Leo said, but he did not touch his dinner.

feedback.es: Después de avoid el verbo va en forma -ing: avoids looking.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué espera Ana.

choices.text: A call from one specific person.

feedback.es: Se levanta con ilusión y se decepciona cuando no es esa llamada: espera a alguien concreto.

origin.audio: Every time the phone rang, Ana jumped up, looked at the screen, and sat down again and sighed.
